sn22.87:1.1: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn22.87:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Vakkali kumbhakāranivesane viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3
sn22.87:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi || ||
sn22.87:1.4: Etha tumhe āvuso yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha || upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha || ||
sn22.87:1.5: Vakkhali bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || so Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti || ||
sn22.87:1.7: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || || 4
sn22.87:1.8: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Vakkalissa paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.87:1.9: Vakkali bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || so Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati ||
sn22.87:1.11: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || ||
sn22.87:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yenāyasmā Vakkali tenupasaṅkami || || 7
sn22.87:2.2: Addasā kho āyasmā Vakkali Bhagavantaṃ dūrato āgacchantaṃ || disvāna mañcake samadhosi || || 8
sn22.87:2.3: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Vakkalim etad avoca || ||
sn22.87:2.4: Alaṃ Vakkali mā tvaṃ mañcake samadhosi ||
sn22.87:2.6: Nisīdi Bhagavā paññatte āsane || || 9 Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Vakkalim etad avoca || ||
sn22.87:2.7: Kacci te Vakkali khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti || paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo ti || ||
sn22.87:2.8: Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 10
sn22.87:2.9: Kacci te Vakkali na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāroti || ||
sn22.87:2.10: Taggha me bhante anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ anappako ca vippaṭisāro ti || 11
sn22.87:2.11: Kacci pana taṃ Vakkali attā sīlato na upavadatīti || ||
sn22.87:2.12: Na kho mam bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti || || 12
sn22.87:2.13: No ce kira tam Vakkali attā sīlato upavadati || atha kiñci te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro ti || ||
sn22.87:2.14: Cirapaṭikāham bhante Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo natthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā || yāyāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan ti || || 13
sn22.87:3.1: Alaṃ Vakkali kiṃ te iminā pūtikāyena diṭṭhena || ||
sn22.87:3.2: Yo kho Vakkali dhammam passati so mam passati ||
sn22.87:3.3: yo maṃ passati so dhammam passati || ||
sn22.87:3.4: Dhammaṃ hi Vakkali passanto maṃ passati
sn22.87:4.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.87:4.12: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ va aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.87:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Vakkaliṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Gijjhakūṭo pabbato tena pakkāmi || || 18
sn22.87:5.2: Atha kho āyasmā Vakkali acirapakkantassa Bhagavato upaṭṭhāke āmantesi || ||
sn22.87:5.3: Etha maṃ āvuso mañcakam āropetvā yena Isigilipassakālasilā tenupasaṅkamatha ||
sn22.87:5.4: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso antaraghare kālam kattabbaṃ maññeyyā ti || || 19
sn22.87:5.5: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ Vakkalim mañcakam āropetvā yena Isigilipassakālasilā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || || 20
sn22.87:5.6: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ ca rattiṃ taṃ ca divasāvasesaṃ Gijjhakūṭe pabbate vihāsi || || 21
sn22.87:5.7: Atha kho dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || la || ekam antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu || || 22
sn22.87:5.8: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.87:5.11: So hi nūna bhante suvimutto vimuccissatīti || || 24
sn22.87:5.13: Idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu || || 25
sn22.87:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn22.87:6.2: Etha tumhe bhikkhave yena Vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatha || upasaṅkamitvā Vakkalim bhikkhum evaṃ vadetha || ||
sn22.87:7.1: Suṇāvuso Vakkali Bhagavato vacanaṃ dvinnaṃ ca devatānaṃ ||
sn22.87:7.2: imam āvuso rattiṃ dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappam Gijjhakūṭam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu || ||
sn22.87:7.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso ekā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.87:7.6: So hi nūna bhante vimutto vimuccissatīti || ||
sn22.87:7.7: Bhagavā ca taṃ āvuso Vakkali evam āha || ||
sn22.87:7.10: apāpakaṃ te maraṇam bhavissati apāpikā kālakiriyāti || || 26
sn22.87:7.11: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā Vakkali tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Vakkalim etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.87:7.12: Suṇāvuso Vakkali Bhagavato vacanaṃ dvinnañ ca devatānan ti || || 27
sn22.87:8.1: Atha kho āyasmā Vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi || ||
sn22.87:8.3: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso ucce āsane nisīditvā tassa Bhagavato sāsanam sotabbam maññeyā ti || || 28
sn22.87:8.4: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ Vakkalim mañcakā oropesuṃ || || 29
sn22.87:8.5: Imaṃ āvuso rattim dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā || la || ekam antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu || ||
sn22.87:8.6: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso ekā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.87:8.9: So hi nūna bhante suvimutto vimuccissatīti || ||
sn22.87:8.10: Bhagavā ca tam āvuso Vakkali evam āha || ||
sn22.87:8.13: te maraṇam bhavissati apāpikā kālakiriyā ti || || 30
sn22.87:8.14: Tena hāvuso mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha || ||
sn22.87:8.15: Vakkali bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
sn22.87:8.20: yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhanti na vicikicchāmi ||
sn22.87:8.21: yad aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā ti na vicikicchāmi || ||

sn22.87:8.34: yad aniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā ti na vicikicchāmīti || || 31
sn22.87:8.35: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Vakkalissa paṭissutvā pakkamiṃsu || || 32
sn22.87:8.36: Atha kho āyasmā Vakkali acirapakkantesu tesu bhikkhūsu sattham āharesi || || 33

sn22.87:10.3: yattha Vakkalinā kulaputtena sattham āharitan ti || ||
sn22.87:10.4: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 35
sn22.87:10.5: Atha kho Bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena Isigilipassakālasilā tenupasaṅkami || || 36

sn22.87:11.1: Tena kho pana samayena dhumāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ || gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati uddham gacchati adho gacchati anudisaṃ || || 38
sn22.87:11.3: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etam dhumāyitattam timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ || la || gacchati anudisanti || ||
sn22.87:11.5: Eso kho bhikkhave Māro pāpimā Vakkalissa kulaputassa viññāṇam samannesati
sn22.87:11.6: Kattha Vakkalissa kulaputtassa viññāṇam patiṭṭhitan ti || || 40
